perfil: Nanoha is a maid working at Goodwind who is also skilled in "Flower" Ninjutsu. She takes pride in her Sunflower Shuriken, which can hit its target while moving at high speed.

builds.d: A build that increases ATK SPD and dart count, with consecutive hits triggering additional AoE DMG.
A build that enhances dart attack range and enables multi-hit DMG, ideal for fighting large targets.

l.b: After Nanoha deals multiple instances of Auto Attack DMG, deals additional AoE Ventus Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: After Nanoha deals DMG with Auto Attacks ⟦0⟧ times, deals an additional ⟦1⟧ as AoE Ventus Auto Attack DMG.

l.b: After casting the Main Skill, Nanoha fires additional shurikens with her Auto Attacks.
l.s: Within 10s after casting Flowers Dance (Main Skill), Nanoha fires ⟦0⟧ additional shurikens with her Auto Attacks that can pierce through the target, each dealing ⟦1⟧ as Ventus Auto Attack DMG.

l.b: Each time Nanoha throws the sunflower shuriken, increases ATK SPD and Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: Each time Nanoha throws the sunflower shuriken during Flowers Dance (Main Skill), increases ATK SPD by ⟦0⟧, and Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: Increases Nanoha's Auto Attack DMG for each active clone. Increases Nanoha's Auto Attack DMG while her Ultimate is on cooldown.
l.s: Increases Nanoha's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧ for each active clone, stacking up to 2 times. Increases Nanoha's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧ while Flowers Thrice (Ultimate) is on cooldown.

l.b: When Nanoha deals DMG, there is a chance to increase her ATK SPD and ATK.
l.s: When Nanoha deals DMG, there is a 30% chance to increase her ATK SPD by ⟦0⟧ and ATK by ⟦1⟧ for 5s.

l.b: The sunflower shuriken can deal DMG multiple times.
l.s: The sunflower shuriken of Flowers Dance (Main Skill) deals DMG multiple times, hitting targets once every ⟦0⟧s.

l.b: Increases sunflower shuriken's DMG and Attack Range.
l.s: Increases the Attack Range of Flowers Dance (Main Skill)'s sunflower shuriken by ⟦0⟧ and its Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, the clones fire sunflower shurikens. Casting Flowers Thrice (Ultimate) increases Nanoha's Skill DMG.
l.s: When casting Flowers Dance (Main Skill), up to 2 active clones fire non-returning sunflower shurikens, each dealing ⟦0⟧ of Nanoha's ATK as Ventus Skill DMG. Casting Flowers Thrice (Ultimate) increases Nanoha's Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 30s.

l.b: The farther the sunflower shuriken is from Nanoha, increases the Skill DMG it deals.
l.s: When the sunflower shuriken cast by Flowers Dance (Main Skill) is farther from Nanoha, increases the Skill DMG it deals by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When the Main Skill triggers ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases Skill DMG.
l.s: When Flowers Dance (Main Skill) triggers a ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, increases ATK.
l.s: When casting Flowers Dance (Main Skill), increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: Nanoha can dodge one more time. Increases her ATK when dodging.
l.s: Nanoha can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 4s.

l.b: When Nanoha triggers ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Nanoha triggers ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 2s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: The clones now follow the main Trekker into combat, their ATK increased.
l.s: The clones now follow the main Trekker into combat. Increases the clones' ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Nanoha's Ultimate DMG. The Ultimate will summon more mirror images.
l.s: Increases Nanoha's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. Flowers Thrice (Ultimate) will summon one additional mirror image. Up to 3 mirror images can exist at the same time.

l.b: Increases Nanoha's ATK and the duration of mirror images.
l.s: Increases Nanoha's ATK by ⟦0⟧.  Also increases the duration of mirror images by ⟦1⟧s.

builds.d: An AoE build that triggers Ventus Marks when hitting multiple targets, reducing cooldown greatly.
A single-target build that continuously tracks and pursues targets, gradually increasing detonation DMG.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG to multiple targets, fires an additional round of shurikens.
l.s: When casting Flowers Bloom (Support Skill), if the first round of shurikens deals DMG to ⟦0⟧ targets, Nanoha will fire ⟦1⟧ additional round of shurikens. This effect can only be triggered once per cast.

l.b: When the Support Skill triggers a ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, causes an explosion and reduces Skill Cooldown.
l.s: When Flowers Bloom (Support Skill) triggers ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, causes an explosion that deals ⟦0⟧ Ventus Skill DMG and reduces Skill Cooldown by ⟦1⟧s. This effect can only be triggered ⟦2⟧ times per Skill cast.

l.b: When an exploding sunflower is conjured, the clones fire multiple small shurikens at nearby targets.
l.s: When an exploding sunflower is conjured, the clones fire 12 shurikens at nearby targets, each dealing ⟦0⟧ of Nanoha's ATK as Ventus Minion DMG.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's Skill DMG dealt to targets with higher HP.
l.s: When casting Flowers Bloom (Support Skill), increases Skill DMG dealt to targets with HP above ⟦0⟧ by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG for the first time, increases Nanoha's Skill DMG.
l.s: When Flowers Bloom (Support Skill) deals DMG for the first time, increases Nanoha's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Shurikens from the Support Skill follow their targets, dealing increased Skill DMG.
l.s: Shurikens from Flowers Bloom (Support Skill) ⟦0⟧ their targets, with Skill DMG increased by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: The Support Skill can inflict Marks. When the exploding sunflower disappears, it detonates all Marks to deal DMG.
l.s: Shurikens from Flowers Bloom (Support Skill) inflict Marks additionally, stacking up to ⟦0⟧ times. When the exploding sunflower disappears, it detonates all Marks, dealing ⟦1⟧ as Ventus Skill DMG. Each stack increases the DMG by ⟦2⟧.

l.b: When an exploding sunflower disappears, the clones fire multiple shurikens forward.
l.s: When an exploding sunflower disappears, the clones fire 5 shurikens forward, each dealing ⟦0⟧ as Ventus Skill DMG.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's Skill DMG dealt to elite or higher-tier targets.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG Flowers Bloom (Support Skill) dealt to elite or higher-tier targets by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's Resilience Break Efficiency.
l.s: Increases the Resilience Break Efficiency of Flowers Bloom (Support Skill) by an additional ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When the Support Skill triggers a ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: When Flowers Bloom (Support Skill) triggers a ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s.

l.b: When the main Trekker casts the Main Skill, increases Nanoha's ATK.
l.s: When the main Trekker casts the Main Skill, increases Nanoha's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 6s.

l.b: When an ally has full Energy, increases Nanoha's Support Skill Skill DMG.
l.s: When an ally has full Energy, increases the Skill DMG of Flowers Bloom (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The clones now follow the main Trekker into combat, their ATK increased.
l.s: The clones now follow the main Trekker into combat. Increases the clones' ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Nanoha's Ultimate DMG. The Ultimate will summon more mirror images.
l.s: Increases Nanoha's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. Flowers Thrice (Ultimate) will summon one additional mirror image. Up to 3 mirror images can exist at the same time.

l.b: Increases Nanoha's ATK and the duration of mirror images.
l.s: Increases Nanoha's ATK by ⟦0⟧.  Also increases the duration of mirror images by ⟦1⟧s.
